source: ocp-mgmt monitoring/prometheus; stored samples queried read-only
method: Original raw API responses retained in ping.json, services.json, pfsense.json, health.json.
WAN Mbps = positive delta(ifHCIn/OutOctets{job=pfsense,ifName=ix2}) * 8 / actual sample interval / 1e6. Interval approximately 60 seconds.
minute-correlation.csv aligns nearest WAN and CPU samples within 60 seconds to each recorded ping-loss timestamp; values are not exact simultaneous measurements.
Ping loss uses existing guarded one-minute recording rules. At 15-second scrape intervals the underlying rate typically spans 45 seconds. Short outages can be shifted by aggregation.
All scrape up series remained 1, all ping validity series remained 1, ping send/receive error counters were zero.
Service failure chart uses the latest sample per target at each 15-second plot step, maximum age 20 seconds, only when all 12 targets have samples.

A separate temporary prober process in the same pod used the same config and a separate localhost listener for 12 seconds, then exited. It received 11 replies from each public target; edge/in-flight effects mean this is not an exact short-run packet loss estimate.
Current original-process counter deltas show 285 requests and zero replies per public target, compared with 285 requests/replies for pfSense.
No firewall, modem, Kubernetes resource, repository, or deployed monitoring configuration was changed.
